LA RÈGLE D'ARMÉE (Code Chivalric) n'est pas câblée : la seule Qualité
qui touche l'attaque donne UNE relance de touche et UNE de blessure, et
le moteur ne connaît que « les 1 » et « les ratés ». Super-heavy Walker
LES LIENS D'ALLÉGEANCE. Un Chevalier en désigne un Armiger : ce sont
des auras d'armée (source = le Chevalier, kw = les Armigers), déclarées
puisque le joueur choisit qui en bénéficie. Celui du Knight Defender
retranche un dégât : la défense ne lit pas cette réduction.

Armiger Warglaive.quand: Le Warglaive a chargé ce tour
Armiger Warglaive.texte: Each time this model makes a charge move, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's reaper chain-cleaver - strike profile.

Armiger Warglaive.quand: Le Warglaive a chargé ce tour
Armiger Warglaive.texte: ... and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's reaper chain-cleaver - sweep profile.

Knight Errant.quand: La cible est l'unité éligible la plus proche
Knight Errant.texte: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Knight Crusader.quand: Le Crusader est resté Stationnaire ce tour
Knight Crusader.texte: In your Movement phase, if this model Remains Stationary, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this model have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Knight Preceptor.quand: La cible est la proie du Preceptor
Knight Preceptor.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets its quarry, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Acastus Knight Porphyrion.quand: Le Porphyrion est resté Stationnaire ce tour
Acastus Knight Porphyrion.texte: Each time this model Remains Stationary, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this model have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Cerastus Knight Atrapos.quand: La cible est TITANESQUE ou IMPOSANTE
Cerastus Knight Atrapos.texte: If that target is TITANIC or TOWERING, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Knight Destrier.quand: Le Destrier porte la lance et l'épée tronçonneuse
Knight Destrier.texte: If this model is equipped with a thundershock spear and a bellatus reaper chainsword, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

Knight Destrier.quand: La cible est à portée d'un pion d'objectif
Knight Destrier.texte: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within range of one or more objective markers, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Knight Warden.texte: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles), that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Acastus Knight Asterius.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.

Cerastus Knight Atrapos.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
